opta_title_prob.note: Pre-tournament 10k-sim title probabilities, top teams + hosts.

eloratings_net.note: World Football Elo for all 48 finalists (strength prior).

market_outright_odds.note: Outright-winner odds (FanDuel via SI) for the 33 informative teams; blended into the prior (Opta-style) to correct Elo's lag on brand teams (Germany/France/England/Brazil). The 15 floored (+250000) minnows are dropped.

market_advance_odds.note: To-advance-to-R32 odds (DraftKings via FOX) for all 48 teams; de-vigged to sum to 32. The key weak-team strength signal (calibrate_team_strengths target).

market_golden_boot_odds.note: Golden Boot odds (DraftKings via RotoWire) for 142 players; de-vigged to sum 1; blended onto players.csv as market_p_gb (top-scorer calibration target).

official_bracket.note: Authoritative R32-Final bracket; the bundled schedule.json had scrambled knockout slots, corrected here.
